name: Castle Locthwain
description: Floating castle of Locthwain that can be moved at its Queen's whim; later converted into a Phyrexian fortress and crashed.

description_citations.text: "Locthwain". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Locthwain's castle is forced aloft by the curse of losing the Cauldron of Eternity.
timeline.quote: Locthwain had been forced aloft long ago by the curse of having lost the embodiment of its precious virtue

citation.text: "Locthwain", section "The castle". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ayara and most of the court of Locthwain are compleated and the castle becomes a Phyrexian fortress.
timeline.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Ayara and most of the court of Locthwain were compleated .

citation.text: "Locthwain", section "The New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rankle's love spell enchants the court and many fall to their deaths from the castle.
timeline.quote: many fell to their deaths from the castle

citation.text: "Locthwain", section "The New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Freed of Phyrexian control, the castle crashes to the ground.
timeline.quote: Without the Phyrexians controlling it, the castle crashed into the ground

citation.text: "Locthwain", section "The New Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rankle steals Torbran's wishing ring and wastes two wishes; his third wish, a rain of love potion, defeats the Phyrexian force.
timeline.quote: Rankle's third wish - a rain of love potion - ended up singlehandedly defeating the Phyrexian force

citation.text: "Torbran", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Eldraine's courts fall within days of Realmbreaker's appearance; the High King and Queen are killed and Ayara is compleated.
timeline.quote: High King Algenus and Queen Linden Kenrith were killed

citation.text: "Wicked Slumber", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
